value.name: watch Medrano trial coverage
value.description: Kenneth watches Court TV coverage of the Medrano murder trial while staring at the chessboard.
evidence:
Kenneth stares at the chessboard. Court TV is on the
background.

COURT TV REPORTER
We are back at the Trial of New Jersey v. Medrano.

value.name: trial recounts Medrano accusation
value.description: The broadcast explains that Medrano is accused of killing his wife Alicia in 1992 and claims she died by suicide.
evidence:
Mr. Medrano
is accused of killing his wife, Alicia in 1992. He claims it
was suicide.

value.name: prosecutor presents handgun evidence
value.description: In the courtroom footage, the prosecutor displays an oversized handgun to the jury and questions the distance needed to avoid powder burns.
evidence: The Prosecutor shows the jury an extremely large handgun.

PROSECUTOR
How far would this gun have to be in
order to inflict a wound without
leaving powder burns on the scalp.

value.name: prosecutor challenges suicide theory
value.description: The prosecutor argues that Mrs. Medrano could not have shot herself in the back of the head from three feet away.
evidence:
PROSECUTOR
And how could Mrs. Medrano shoot
herself in the back of the head from
a distance of three feet?

value.name: kenneth jokes about long arms
value.description: Kenneth sarcastically suggests that Mrs. Medrano could have done it with very long arms.

value.name: kenneth moves chess piece
value.description: Kenneth makes a move on the chessboard as he talks with Miles.

value.name: miles doubts conviction
value.description: Miles says the prosecution will not get a conviction because the death was initially reported as a suicide and the evidence was compromised.
evidence:
MILES
They won't get a conviction. The
husband called it in as a suicide.
The forensic guys weren't thinking
murder. I'm sure some of the evidence
was compromised.

value.name: kenneth prompts miles to move
value.description: Kenneth tells Miles it is his turn in the chess game.

value.name: miles admits he already moved
value.description: Miles sadly reveals that he has already made his move, implying Kenneth missed it.
evidence:
MILES
(Sadly)
I already made my move, Kenneth.
